name: patchversion
description: Early-stage prototype: local proof loop for breaking SDK changes (call-site mapping, deterministic rename fix, test rerun). Live watching and PR delivery are in development.

scripts.build: node scripts/hosted-db-guard.js strip -- sh -c 'npm run build -w @patchversion/shared && npm run build -w @patchversion/engine && npm run build -w @patchversion/site'
scripts.test: node scripts/hosted-db-guard.js strip -- sh -c 'npm run build -w @patchversion/shared && npm run build -w @patchversion/engine && npm run test --workspaces'
scripts.test:postgres: node scripts/hosted-db-guard.js local-test -- npm run test:postgres -w @patchversion/engine
scripts.typecheck: node scripts/hosted-db-guard.js strip -- sh -c 'npm run build -w @patchversion/shared && npm run build -w @patchversion/engine && npm run typecheck --workspaces'
scripts.prove: node scripts/hosted-db-guard.js strip -- sh -c 'npm run build -w @patchversion/shared && npm run build -w @patchversion/engine && npm run prove -w @patchversion/engine'
scripts.prove:real: node scripts/hosted-db-guard.js strip -- sh -c 'npm run build -w @patchversion/shared && npm run build -w @patchversion/engine && npm run prove:real -w @patchversion/engine'
scripts.readiness: node scripts/hosted-db-guard.js strip -- sh -c 'npm run build -w @patchversion/shared && npm run build -w @patchversion/engine && npm run readiness -w @patchversion/engine'
scripts.db:migrate: node scripts/hosted-db-guard.js strip -- sh -c 'npm run build -w @patchversion/shared && npm run build -w @patchversion/engine' && npm run db:migrate -w @patchversion/engine
scripts.db:status: node scripts/hosted-db-guard.js strip -- sh -c 'npm run build -w @patchversion/shared && npm run build -w @patchversion/engine' && npm run db:status -w @patchversion/engine
scripts.db:verify: node scripts/hosted-db-guard.js strip -- sh -c 'npm run build -w @patchversion/shared && npm run build -w @patchversion/engine' && npm run db:verify -w @patchversion/engine
